title: Parallel-Trends & Placebo Checker
description: A difference-in-differences companion that tests the identifying assumption instead of asserting it. Enter 3 or more pre-treatment periods for a treatment group and a control group to get a pre-trend slope gap with a t-test, an event-study table of period-by-period treatment-minus-control differences relative to a baseline period, and an in-time placebo test that reruns the difference-in-differences estimate at a fake treatment date inside the pre-period. A classic single pre/post 2x2 difference-in-differences tab is included for completeness only; it is already served by other calculators in this suite.
data_vintage: No live or refreshable data. The built-in worked example is an illustrative synthetic panel, not a historical dataset. All arithmetic runs on user-entered period values.
regulatory_citations: Mantel, N., Haenszel, W. (1959). "Statistical Aspects of the Analysis of Data from Retrospective Studies of Disease." Journal of the National Cancer Institute 22(4):719-748 (Mantel-Haenszel style stratified pooling, the same closed-form pooling family this suite already uses for related diagnostics).

Autor, D.H. (2003). "Outsourcing at Will: The Contribution of Unjust Dismissal Doctrine to the Growth of Employment Outsourcing." Journal of Labor Economics 21(1):1-42 (event-study specification for testing pre-trends in a difference-in-differences design).

mcp_tool_definition.name: parallel_trends_placebo_checker
mcp_tool_definition.description: Test the parallel-trends assumption behind a difference-in-differences design: compute a pre-trend slope gap with a t-test, an event-study table of period-by-period treatment-minus-control differences, and an in-time placebo difference-in-differences estimate at a fake treatment date inside the pre-period.

treatment_start_period.description: Label of the first post-treatment period; all periods before it are treated as pre-treatment

placebo_period.description: Label of a pre-treatment period to treat as a fake treatment date for the in-time placebo test
